Plugin.Name: UGREEN LED Control
Plugin.Overview: NO LONGER DEVELOPED: use UGREEN NAS Control instead (also in the Apps tab). It includes everything of this plugin, adds fan control and more, and is developed from now on. Switch by installing UGREEN NAS Control and taking over the LED settings on its LEDs page, then remove this plugin: both write the same LEDs, and removing it deletes its saved settings. This plugin stays as it is, with no more fixes or new models. What it does: LED control for UGREEN DX/DXP NAS devices. Colour, brightness and effect for every front LED, a status mode for disk activity, disk errors, SMART warnings, parity checks, link speed and standby, night mode, a shutdown signal on the power LED and a dashboard tile.
